earlier_web_judgment_basis: Fresh publisher-web representations, with raw-byte identity explicitly unproven

semantic_findings.predicate: The announced memory configuration is intended for inclusion in the named downstream accelerator product.
semantic_findings.separate_context_fact: The surrounding paragraph reports that Micron memory production had begun; this does not convert the downstream planned integration or expected shipping into completed delivery.
semantic_findings.downstream_shipping_period: calendar Q2 2024 as the source's expectation

representation_qualification.implication: The candidate's source span carries the H200 constraint while its typed product_scope identifies the memory configuration. Any later observation or display must preserve both the source span and this downstream constraint; interpreting the object label as all NVIDIA products would overstate the evidence.
representation_qualification.semantic_scope_versioning: Keep this source-specific qualifier with the immutable judgment reference; later corrections require a new observation/review revision.

excluded_inferences: Completed customer shipments or invoice counterparty
Shipment count, fixed order volume, realized revenue, or exposure weights from product capacity/specifications
Canonical legal-entity or security IDs from source labels
A precise publication instant or system possession in 2024 from the printed source date
Authenticated capture actor, publisher custody or licensed processing purpose
falsifiers_and_required_evidence: A view that marks the integration as delivered using only the nearby production statement fails this retained source's tense distinction.
Dropping H200 or the specified memory configuration fails the bounded product predicate.
Actual delivery, revised configuration, discontinuation, procurement allocation or current continuation requires separately dated primary evidence; elapsed time is not such evidence.
A hash/coordinate mismatch would invalidate this byte-bound judgment and require a new record.
scope_of_acceptance: Suitable evidence for an unadmitted document-scoped current-inspection observation with this exact candidate/source/span and the stated qualifiers.
